predicate.label: directed communication to
predicate.definition: Person or institution X directs information, speech, request, advice, warning or a message to addressee Y.
includes: institutional communication through an identified representative
excludes: speaking about or criticizing Y without address
ambiguous: send/submit/give with omitted object and no other clear communication in this fact
person versus their administration or envoy attribution
predicate.notes: An unqualified send-to edge does not by itself recover a message. Case-local corroboration may resolve it.
predicate.scope_notes: Includes: tell/ask/urge/notify/advise/warn/persuade/address/speak-to; testimony before the addressee; send/submit a clearly communicative object; institutional communication through an identified representative. Excludes: mere meeting/cooperation/support; speaking about or criticizing Y without address; physical transfer; spokesperson intermediary treated as recipient. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: send/submit/give with omitted object and no other clear communication in this fact; person versus their administration or envoy attribution. An unqualified send-to edge does not by itself recover a message. Case-local corroboration may resolve it.

rationale: Urge/tell/speak/suggest/report dominates communication to an addressee. Say-of or speaking against a comment need not address its subject.
